title: Poulsbo Heritage Museum

services.name: Martinson Cabin
services.desc: Built in 1897 by the Martinson Family, this cabin was carefully relocated to its current site in 2006 in order to preserve this significant historical landmark. It also offers residents and visitors a wonderful opportunity to experience the lifestyle of early Poulsbo pioneers. A variety of items, including tools, transportation equipment, and laundry artifacts, are on display to inspire visitors and provide a glimpse into the daily life of early Poulsbo pioneers.
